questions.title: Circle Area Using a Method
questions.description:
Write a program that reads the radius of a circle and uses a static method to compute and return its area. The method must take the radius as a parameter and return the area as a double. Read the radius in main, call the method, and print the returned value.

Input Format:
A single line containing one number, the radius r.

Output Format:
Print the area rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Constraints:
0 < r <= 10000

questions.title: Maximum of Three Using a Method
questions.description:
Write a program with a static method maxOfThree that receives three integers as parameters and returns the largest of them. Read the three integers in main, call the method, and print the returned value.

Input Format:
A single line with three space-separated integers a, b and c.

Output Format:
Print one line: the largest of the three values.

Constraints:
-100000 <= a, b, c <= 100000

questions.title: Prime Check Using a Method
questions.description:
Write a program with a static boolean method isPrime that takes an integer parameter and returns true when the number is prime and false otherwise. Read n in main, call the method, and print the returned boolean (lowercase true or false).

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer n.

Output Format:
Print true if n is prime, otherwise false.

Constraints:
0 <= n <= 1000000000

questions.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit Converter Method
questions.description:
Write a program with a static method toFahrenheit that receives a temperature in Celsius as a parameter and returns the temperature in Fahrenheit using the formula F = C * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0. Read the Celsius value in main, pass it to the method, and print the returned value rounded to 2 decimal places.

Input Format:
A single line containing one number, the temperature in Celsius.

Output Format:
Print the Fahrenheit value rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Constraints:
-100 <= c <= 200

questions.title: Count Vowels in a Word Using a Method
questions.description:
Write a program with a static method countVowels that receives a word as a parameter and returns how many vowels (a, e, i, o, u in lower or upper case) the word contains. Read the word in main, call the method, and print the returned count.

Input Format:
A single line containing one word without spaces.

Output Format:
Print one line: the number of vowels in the word.

Constraints:
1 <= length of word <= 1000, letters only

questions.title: Swap Attempt and Call by Value
questions.description:
Java always passes arguments by value. Write a program that demonstrates this: a static method attemptSwap receives two integers as parameters, swaps its local copies, and prints them in the form Inside method: X Y. After the call, main prints the original variables in the form Original values: A B. The originals must remain unchanged because the method only swapped copies.

Input Format:
A single line with two space-separated integers a and b.

Output Format:
Line 1: Inside method: Y X (the swapped copies inside the method)
Line 2: Original values: a b (the unchanged originals in main)

Constraints:
-1000000 <= a, b <= 1000000

questions.title: Invoice Line Total Method
questions.description:
A shopkeeper bills items using a small program. Write a static method lineTotal that receives the quantity, the unit price and a boolean discount flag as parameters and returns the line total as a double. The total is quantity times unit price; when the discount flag is true, reduce the total by 10 percent. Read the inputs in main, build the boolean flag, and print the returned total rounded to 2 decimal places.

Input Format:
A single line with three space-separated values: quantity (integer), unit price (number) and discount flag (1 for discount applied, 0 for no discount).

Output Format:
Print the line total rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Constraints:
1 <= quantity <= 10000, 0 < unit price <= 100000, flag is 0 or 1
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= quantity <= 10000, 0 < unit price <= 100000, flag is 0 or 1

questions.title: Grade Point Mapper Method
questions.description:
A university converts marks into grade points with a static method gradePoint that receives the marks and returns an int using this ladder: 90 or more returns 10, 80 to 89 returns 9, 70 to 79 returns 8, 60 to 69 returns 7, 50 to 59 returns 6, and below 50 returns 0. Read the marks in main, call the method, and print the returned grade point.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer marks.

Output Format:
Print one line: the grade point.

Constraints:
0 <= marks <= 100

questions.title: Tip Calculator Method
questions.description:
A restaurant app computes tips with a static method tipAmount that receives the bill amount and the tip rate as parameters and returns the tip as bill * rate / 100.0. In main, read the bill and the rate, call the method, and print two lines: first the tip, then the total (bill plus tip), both rounded to 2 decimal places.

Input Format:
A single line with two space-separated numbers: bill and rate (rate is a percentage, e.g. 10 means 10 percent).

Output Format:
Line 1: the tip rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.
Line 2: the total (bill plus tip) rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Constraints:
1 <= bill <= 100000, 0 <= rate <= 50

questions.title: Payroll Gross Salary Method
questions.description:
A small company computes gross salary with modular methods. Write three static methods: hra(basic) returning 20 percent of basic, da(basic) returning 10 percent of basic, and grossSalary(basic) returning basic plus hra plus da by calling the other two methods. Read the basic salary in main and print the returned gross salary rounded to 2 decimal places.

Input Format:
A single line containing one number, the basic monthly salary.

Output Format:
Print the gross salary rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Constraints:
1 <= basic <= 1000000

questions.title: EMI Calculator with Helper Methods
questions.description:
A bank wants a small EMI calculator built with modular methods. Write a static method monthlyRate(annualPercent) that returns the annual rate divided by 12 and then by 100, and a static method emi(principal, annualPercent, months) that returns the monthly installment using the reducing-balance formula: EMI = P * r * (1 + r)^n / ((1 + r)^n - 1), where r is the monthly rate and n is the number of months. Use Math.pow for the power. Read principal, annual rate and months in main and print the returned EMI rounded to 2 decimal places.

Input Format:
A single line with three space-separated values: principal (number), annual rate in percent (number) and months (integer).

Output Format:
Print the EMI rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Constraints:
1 <= principal <= 10000000, 0.1 <= rate <= 60, 1 <= months <= 360

questions.title: Electricity Bill with Slab Methods
questions.description:
A power company computes monthly bills with slab rates using modular methods. Write three static methods that each return a double: firstSlab(units) charging 3.50 per unit for the first 100 units, secondSlab(units) charging 4.60 per unit for units from 101 to 200, and thirdSlab(units) charging 6.50 per unit for units above 200. Write a fourth static method totalBill(units) that returns the sum of the three slab charges. Read the units consumed in main and print the returned total rounded to 2 decimal places.

Input Format:
A single line containing one integer: units consumed.

Output Format:
Print the total bill rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Constraints:
1 <= units <= 100000

questions.title: Unit Converter Suite
questions.description:
Build a modular unit converter. Write four static methods that each receive a double and return a double: cmToInch(v) = v / 2.54, inchToCm(v) = v * 2.54, kgToLb(v) = v * 2.20462 and lbToKg(v) = v / 2.20462. In main, read a choice (1 to 4) and a value, use a switch statement as the dispatcher to call the matching method, and print the returned result rounded to 2 decimal places.

Input Format:
A single line with two space-separated values: choice (1 to 4) and value (number).

Output Format:
Print the converted value rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Constraints:
1 <= choice <= 4, 0 < value <= 100000

questions.title: Word Statistics Module
questions.description:
A text tool reports word statistics through modular methods. Write three static methods that each receive the text and return an int: countWords(text) counting words separated by one or more spaces, countVowels(text) counting vowels (a, e, i, o, u in lower or upper case) and countUppercase(text) counting uppercase letters A to Z. Read one line of text in main and print the three results on three separate lines in this order.

Input Format:
A single line of text (may contain spaces).

Output Format:
Line 1: number of words.
Line 2: number of vowels.
Line 3: number of uppercase letters.

Constraints:
1 <= length of text <= 2000

questions.title: Prime Numbers in a Range Using a Method
questions.description:
A math helper prints all prime numbers in a range using a reusable method. Write a static boolean method isPrime(n) that returns true when n is prime. In main, read two integers a and b and, for every number from a to b, call isPrime and print each prime on its own line.

Input Format:
A single line with two space-separated integers a and b.

Output Format:
Each prime in the range [a, b] on its own line, in increasing order.

Constraints:
1 <= a <= b <= 50000, and the range always contains at least one prime
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= a <= b <= 50000, range contains at least one prime

questions.title: GCD and LCM with Euclid Method
questions.description:
A number theory tool needs two reusable methods. Write a static long method gcd(a, b) that uses a while loop with Euclid's algorithm (repeatedly replace the pair with (b, a mod b) until b becomes 0) and returns the greatest common divisor. Write a static long method lcm(a, b) that returns a divided by gcd times b. Read two integers in main and print the gcd, then the lcm, on separate lines.

Input Format:
A single line with two space-separated integers a and b.

Output Format:
Line 1: the greatest common divisor.
Line 2: the least common multiple.

Constraints:
1 <= a, b <= 1000000000

questions.title: Payroll Engine with Slab Tax Methods
questions.description:
A payroll engine computes a monthly salary slip with modular static methods. Given the basic monthly salary: hra is 20 percent of basic, da is 10 percent of basic, gross = basic + hra + da, and pf is 8 percent of basic. Annual gross is gross times 12. Annual tax uses slabs: up to 250000 pays nothing, up to 500000 pays 10 percent of the amount above 250000, up to 1000000 pays 12500 plus 20 percent of the amount above 500000, and above 1000000 pays 112500 plus 30 percent of the amount above 1000000. Monthly tax is annual tax divided by 12. Net = gross - pf - monthly tax. Read the basic salary and print four lines: gross, pf, monthly tax and net, each rounded to 2 decimal places.

Input Format:
A single line containing one number: the basic monthly salary.

Output Format:
Line 1: gross salary.
Line 2: pf.
Line 3: monthly tax.
Line 4: net salary.
All four rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Constraints:
1 <= basic <= 1000000

questions.title: Compound Savings Projector
questions.description:
A savings app projects compound growth without using Math.pow. Write a static double method power(base, exp) that computes base raised to a non-negative integer exponent with a plain for loop of repeated multiplication and returns the result. In main, read a principal, an annual interest rate in percent and the number of years; compute the final amount as principal times power(1 + rate / 100.0, years) and the interest earned as amount minus principal. Print the final amount, then the interest earned, each rounded to 2 decimal places.

Input Format:
A single line with three space-separated values: principal (number), annual rate in percent (number) and years (integer).

Output Format:
Line 1: final amount after compounding, rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.
Line 2: interest earned, rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Constraints:
1 <= principal <= 10000000, 0 < rate <= 50, 1 <= years <= 30

questions.title: Grade Analytics with Array Methods
questions.description:
A teacher analyzes class results by passing the marks array to static methods. Write three static methods: average(marks) returning the mean as a double, highest(marks) returning the maximum mark as an int, and passCount(marks) returning how many marks are 40 or more as an int. Read n and then n marks in main, store them in an int array, pass that array to each method, and print three lines: the average rounded to 2 decimal places, the highest mark, and the pass count.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of students.
Line 2: n space-separated integers, the marks.

Output Format:
Line 1: average rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.
Line 2: highest mark.
Line 3: number of students with marks >= 40.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 1000, 0 <= marks <= 100

questions.title: Caesar Shift Encoder Method
questions.description:
A secret-note app encodes messages with a Caesar-style shift built around a single-character method. Write a static char method shiftChar(c, k) that receives one character and a shift k and returns the shifted character: lowercase letters wrap within a to z, uppercase letters wrap within A to Z, and any other character is returned unchanged. In main, read the shift k and then one line of text, build the encoded text by calling shiftChar for every character (store the results in a char array), and print the encoded line.

Input Format:
Line 1: the shift k (integer).
Line 2: the text to encode (single line, may contain spaces and digits).

Output Format:
Print one line: the encoded text.

Constraints:
0 <= k <= 25, 1 <= text length <= 2000, text contains at least one letter and has no leading or trailing spaces
questions.inputconstrains: 0 <= k <= 25, 1 <= text length <= 2000, at least one letter, no leading or trailing spaces
